description: ZVV Fahrplan Tram und Bus (Static GTFS) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Zürich. Fahrplandaten der Tram- und Buslinien im ZVV-Gebiet. Der Fahrplan enthält die grundlegenden topologischen, sowie die zeitlichen Element, die eine Fahrplandarstellung und -auskunft ermöglichen. Der Fahrplan wird mittels des «General Transit Feed Specification Format» (GTFS Static) zur Verfügung gestellt. Coverage: Stadt Zürich. The portal files it under the publisher Stadt Zürich. It offers 11 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
